nodes.name: Compiler Design

topics.title: Lexical analysis and parsing (LL and LR)

miniTasks: Build FIRST/FOLLOW sets and an LL(1) table for two grammars.
Generate three-address code for 5 expressions and control-flow statements.
Apply common optimisations to a basic block and draw its DAG.

resources.why: Build a language implementation step by step; excellent project-oriented compiler learning.

resources.why: Walks learners through building a scanner/lexer for Lox, giving a concrete first compiler front-end implementation rather than only conceptual explanations.

resources.why: Implement a stack-based virtual-machine translator to understand intermediate representations and function-level code generation.

resources.why: Builds the compiler front end through lexical analysis, parsing, and syntax-tree-oriented translation.

resources.title: GeeksforGeeks Compiler Design
resources.why: Topic-wise notes for lexical analysis, parsing, syntax trees, intermediate code, and optimization.

resources.title: LLVM Kaleidoscope Tutorial

resources.title: NPTEL – Compiler Design
resources.why: Lecture catalog for compiler architecture and language-processing fundamentals.

resources.title: Gate Smashers – Compiler Design Complete Playlist
resources.why: Specific compiler-design playlist covering lexical analysis, parsing and later compiler topics.
